verdict.rationale: The Jobs API create endpoint documents an option that "parses speakers from multi-channel audio by assigning one speaker per channel," which keeps each side of a stereo call separate as distinct speakers. Combined with per-segment speaker_id output, this delivers the core of the story. missing for 10: parameter name and output-format details for per-channel results, documented channel-count limits and stereo-specific behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
